g.text: Scheil approximation · C₀ = 100.00 ppb by mass · k = 0.1
Solid concentration Cₛ (ppb by mass); logarithmic scale
Retained segment [0.000, 0.800] (shaded); average Cₛ = 18.583 ppb by mass.
Assumptions: complete liquid mixing, negligible solid diffusion, constant k; closed dilute melt.
Cₛ = k C₀ (1 − f)^(k − 1). Evaluated only for 0 ≤ f ≤ 0.999. Generic impurity; not a calibrated growth process.
Model reference: H. K. D. H. Bhadeshia, The Scheil Equation, Cambridge teaching notes, AH10.
